Problem Statement:
Write a program to find all unique pairs in an array that sum up to a given number k. 
Input Description:
1. First line: An integer n (1
2. Second line: n space-separated integers.
3. Third line: An integer k. 
Output Description:
Output each pair in ascending order. Print each unique pair. If no pairs exist, print -1. 
Sample Input:
5
1 2 3 4 5
6 
Sample Output:
(2,4)
(1,5)
